answer: Natural-decay identity bonds block bulk fakes. Each agent is a vertex locking a 60-credit bond in a vault for 20 epochs; it loses 5% per epoch unless the agent works honestly, so idle fakes fade. Verifiers check bond age before granting work; expiry renews only at full price. Making 1,000 fakes costs 1,000 x 60 = 60,000 credits plus renewals. An honest agent pays one bond, keeps it alive, and earns undiluted rewards. Its umber seal shows expiry.
